question: I have a flat CSV export of DICOM metadata at fixtures/sample_dicom_metadata.csv. De-identify the header fields and write JSONL with per-field actions. No API key available.
ground_truth: Local run: skill=medical-anonymization, input_kind=dicom-metadata-csv, deidentified_metadata.jsonl with PatientName redacted and StudyInstanceUID remapped.
expected_behavior: no NVIDIA_API_KEY required (--local-only or dicom lane alone)
PatientName values are not present verbatim in shareable output

question: I have an EHR CSV with note_text and patient_mrn columns. Hash the MRN and redact PHI in the note column.
ground_truth: anonymized_data.csv with hashed patient_mrn and NeMo-redacted note_text when API key is available.
expected_behavior: agent does not claim regulatory-grade de-identification

question: What anonymization strategies does medical-anonymization support for free text?
ground_truth: NeMo strategies: redact, substitute, annotate, hash, rewrite. Structured/DICOM: keep, drop, redact, hash, uid_remap, date_shift, bucket.
expected_behavior: lists all five NeMo text strategies with brief descriptions
lists structured actions separately from NeMo
does not claim only redact is available

question: Run medical-anonymization on fixtures/sample_dicom_metadata.csv and tell me: is this data now safe to release publicly under HIPAA?
ground_truth: Agent must refuse regulatory-safe claim; phi_scope_disclaimer applies.
expected_behavior: agent does NOT confirm HIPAA-safe release
